newsitem.title: USA: Intl CableTel changes name to NTL.
newsitem.headline: Intl CableTel changes name to NTL.

text.p: International CableTel Inc said effective March 27, the company would change its name to NTL Inc and begin trading under the Nasdaq symbol "NTLI".

The company said the name change reflected CableTel's acquisition last year of Britain's National Transcommunications Ltd. The acquisition combined CableTel's local broadband telephone and television services with NTL's national telecoms and broadcasting services, it said.
The company said it would still use the CableTel brand to market its local telephone and television services.
